resources.string: Track Me Live uses your location only while you’re sharing. Nobody sees it until you send your link, and it stops when you do.
Location is off for Track Me Live
To share where you are, allow location in Settings. It’s only used while you share.
Location is off on this phone
To share where you are, turn on location in Settings. It’s only used while you share.
Know when your link is opened
Turn on alerts to hear when your link is opened, when a call ends while you’re sharing, and when sharing stops.
